senses.en: past events, or the study of them

ex.en: We have a history test on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们周五有历史测验。

ex.en: Local history is easier to care about when students can visit the street the textbook describes.
ex.zh: 当学生能去教科书描写的那条街时，本地历史就更容易让人在意。

tip: history 作学科不可数。historical 是“历史的”；historic 常指有历史意义的。

senses.en: not including

ex.en: Everyone was present except Tom.
ex.zh: 除了汤姆，大家都到了。

ex.en: The museum is free except on the one day when a special show raises the price.
ex.zh: 除了特别展览涨价的那一天，博物馆都是免费的。

tip: except 表示排除；besides 表示除此之外还有。

senses.en: not firmly fixed, or not tight

ex.en: The lock is loose.
ex.zh: 锁松了。

ex.en: A loose wheel on the cart is a reason to stop before the hill.
ex.zh: 手推车轮子松了，是在上坡前停下来的理由。

tip: 不要和 lose（丢失）混淆。tight 已在本库。

senses.en: newly made or picked, or clean and new

ex.en: The canteen has fresh fruit on Monday.
ex.zh: 食堂周一有新鲜水果。

ex.en: Fresh air in a classroom depends on windows that actually open, not only on a poster.
ex.zh: 教室里的新鲜空气取决于窗户真的能开，而不只是一张海报。

tip: fresh water 是淡水，不是“刚接的水”这一个意思。

senses.en: a workers' organisation, or a joining together

ex.en: The union asked for safer night buses.
ex.zh: 工会要求更安全的夜班公交。

ex.en: A union of small shops can buy together and keep a market alive.
ex.zh: 小店的联合可以一起进货，并让市场继续活着。

tip: the European Union 是欧洲联盟。

senses.en: to clean with water
an act of washing

ex.en: Wash your hands before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前洗手。

ex.en: A place to wash near the canteen prevents more illness than a poster.
ex.zh: 食堂附近一个能洗手的地方，比一张海报更能减少疾病。

tip: wash 作名词是洗。表里这一行的音标是 warning，本库不用。

senses.en: a ceremony for a person who has died

ex.en: The class sent a letter after the funeral.
ex.zh: 葬礼之后班级送了一封信。

ex.en: A school should leave time for a funeral without asking the student to explain it in public.
ex.zh: 学校应当为葬礼留出时间，而不要求学生当众解释。

tip: funeral 可数。说话时要尊重。

senses.en: a team game played with an oval ball

ex.en: Rugby practice is on the field.
ex.zh: 橄榄球训练在场上。

ex.en: Rugby needs a safe surface, not only a poster of a cup.
ex.zh: 橄榄球需要安全的场地，而不只是一张奖杯海报。

tip: play rugby 不加 the。

senses.en: great honour and praise

ex.en: The glory belongs to the whole team.
ex.zh: 光荣属于整支队伍。

ex.en: Glory on a poster does not name who locked the door.
ex.zh: 海报上的光荣不会写出是谁锁的门。

tip: glory 通常不可数。

senses.en: without being affected by something

ex.en: The bus left regardless of the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下雨，公交还是开了。

ex.en: Every student may use the library regardless of the score.
ex.zh: 不论分数，每个学生都可以用图书馆。

tip: 固定搭配 regardless of。表里把它标成形容词，本库按副词用。

senses.en: whether a person is male or female

ex.en: The form asks for your name and sex.
ex.zh: 表格要填写姓名和性别。

ex.en: A school sports rule based only on sex can be unfair if it ignores what each student can actually do.
ex.zh: 只按性别制定的学校体育规则，如果忽略每个学生实际能做什么，就可能不公平。

tip: sex 在考纲里主要作“性别”，填写表格时用。

senses.en: a very small cause of disease, or a harmful computer program

ex.en: The clinic explained the virus without a scare.
ex.zh: 医务室解释了这种病毒，没有制造恐慌。

ex.en: A computer virus is a reason to keep a paper copy of the class list.
ex.zh: 计算机病毒是给班级名单留一份纸质副本的理由。

tip: virus 可数。本条不写如何制造或传播病毒。

senses.en: simple, or easy to see
a large area of flat land

ex.en: The notice is in plain words.
ex.zh: 通知用的是明白的话。

ex.en: A plain meal that students can afford is better than a picture of a feast.
ex.zh: 学生买得起的普通一餐，好过一张盛宴的图片。

tip: plain 作名词是平原。

senses.en: of the Roman Catholic Church
a member of the Roman Catholic Church

ex.en: The old church in the story is Catholic.
ex.zh: 故事里的老教堂是天主教的。

ex.en: A history class can explain a Catholic festival without telling students to join it.
ex.zh: 历史课可以讲解一个天主教节日，而不要求学生加入。

tip: Catholic 作宗教名要大写。本条是词汇，不是劝人信教。

senses.en: a result
To bring about a change or result.

ex.en: Sleep has a strong effect on mood.
ex.zh: 睡眠对情绪有强烈影响。

ex.en: Higher parking charges may have little effect on traffic unless reliable public transport is also available.
ex.zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，提高停车费对交通状况的影响可能很小。

col: have an effect on｜对……有影响
tip: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。

senses.en: a senior university teacher

ex.en: The professor answered questions after the talk.
ex.zh: 教授在讲座后回答了问题。

ex.en: A visiting professor can show students how research looks outside their own textbook.
ex.zh: 客座教授能让学生看到研究在自己课本之外是什么样。

tip: professor 是大学里的高级职称，中学老师一般称 teacher。

senses.en: holding one's attention

ex.en: The talk was interesting.
ex.zh: 讲座很有趣。

ex.en: An interesting museum is still out of reach if the bus fare is too high.
ex.zh: 如果公交票价太高，有趣的博物馆仍然到不了。

tip: interesting 修饰事物；interested 修饰人。

senses.en: very great, or very far in one direction

ex.en: The extreme heat closed the afternoon sport.
ex.zh: 极端高温让下午的体育停了。

ex.en: Extreme views in a debate still have to answer the same question: what happens to the bus?
ex.zh: 辩论里的极端观点，仍然必须回答同一个问题：公交怎么办？

tip: extreme 作名词可指极端。go to extremes 是走极端。

senses.en: a grain, or the food made from it

ex.en: There is rice in the bowl.
ex.zh: 碗里有米饭。

ex.en: Rice left out all morning is not a safe lunch.
ex.zh: 放了一上午的米饭不是安全的午饭。

col: a bowl of rice｜一碗米饭
tip: rice 通常不可数。不说 a rice。

senses.en: help
to help

ex.en: The clinic keeps a first-aid box by the door.
ex.zh: 医务室在门边放着急救箱。

ex.en: Food aid after a flood helps for a week; repairing the road helps for years.
ex.zh: 洪水后的食品援助能帮上一周，修路则能帮上很多年。

tip: aid 作动词是帮助，比 help 正式。

senses.en: a part of a place, or the size of a surface

ex.en: This area of the library is for quiet study.
ex.zh: 图书馆这一区是安静学习用的。

ex.en: Industrial areas beside rivers need stricter rules, because waste travels farther than the factory gate.
ex.zh: 河边的工业区需要更严的规定，因为废物会流到比厂门更远的地方。

tip: area 可指地区或面积，面积不可数时仍说 an area of。

senses.en: to become better or make something better

ex.en: Reading aloud can improve your pronunciation.
ex.zh: 朗读能改进你的发音。

ex.en: Towns improve a bus line by counting who is left at the stop, not only who is already on board.
ex.zh: 城镇改进公交线路，要数还留在车站的人，而不只是已经上车的人。

tip: improve 可及物也可不及物：improve English；English improves。

senses.en: a piece of writing in verse

ex.en: The poem is on the wall.
ex.zh: 这首诗在墙上。

ex.en: A poem about a flood can start a discussion, and the bus time still has to be fact.
ex.zh: 写洪水的诗可以开启讨论，公交时间却必须是事实。

tip: poem 可数。

senses.en: firm and hard, or reliable
a substance that is not a liquid or a gas

ex.en: Ice is solid water.
ex.zh: 冰是固态的水。

ex.en: A solid plan names who locks the door, not only what the poster says.
ex.zh: 扎实的计划会写明谁锁门，而不只是海报上的话。

tip: solid 作名词是固体。

senses.en: a soft white material from a plant
made of cotton

ex.en: The shirt is cotton.
ex.zh: 这件衬衫是棉的。

ex.en: Cotton dries faster than a coat left in a pile.
ex.zh: 棉布比堆着的外套干得快。

tip: cotton 作材料通常不可数。也可作形容词。

senses.en: to ask formally; to use
To use something practically, or be relevant to a situation
To spread a substance onto a surface

ex.en: She will apply for a scholarship.
ex.zh: 她将申请奖学金。

ex.en: Universities should encourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for scholarships that cover tuition and living expenses.
ex.zh: 大学应鼓励家庭条件困难的学生申请涵盖学费和生活费的奖学金。

col: apply for a job｜申请工作
apply to a university｜向大学提出申请
tip: apply for接申请事项；apply to接机构或适用对象。

senses.en: not dirty
to make something not dirty

ex.en: The lab must be clean before we leave.
ex.zh: 离开前实验室必须干净。

ex.en: Clean drinking water is a public duty, not a luxury for one neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 干净的饮用水是公共责任，不是一个社区的奢侈。

tip: clean 作动词是“打扫”。

senses.en: to cut with the teeth, or to sting
a small mouthful, or a wound from a bite

ex.en: The dog did not bite.
ex.zh: 狗没有咬人。

ex.en: A bite from an insect is a reason to see the clinic.
ex.zh: 被虫子叮了是去医务室的理由。

tip: 过去式 bit，过去分词 bitten。本条不写如何伤害。

senses.en: happening at once
prepared very quickly, usually by adding hot water
an extremely short period of time

ex.en: She got an instant reply.
ex.zh: 她得到了立即回复。

ex.en: Digital platforms provide instant access to educational resources, although reliable internet connections remain essential.
ex.zh: 数字平台让人们即时获取教育资源，但稳定的网络连接仍然必不可少。

tip: instant作形容词表示即时的；in an instant表示转眼间。

senses.en: a final decision or end
the final part or ending of something

ex.en: The conclusion of the report is clear.
ex.zh: 报告的结论很清楚。

ex.en: Researchers should consider alternative explanations before drawing a conclusion from a relatively small sample.
ex.zh: 研究人员根据较小的样本得出结论之前，应考虑其他可能的解释。

tip: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。

senses.en: trade, a company, or a matter to deal with

ex.en: Her aunt runs a small business near the station.
ex.zh: 她阿姨在车站附近做小生意。

ex.en: A business that ignores its waste may save money this year and lose the trust of the town next year.
ex.zh: 忽视废弃物的企业今年也许省了钱，明年却可能失去城镇的信任。

col: none of one's business｜不关某人的事
tip: business 表示生意时可不可数；表示一家企业时可数。

senses.en: the way people or things are connected

ex.en: The relationship between the two clubs is friendly.
ex.zh: 两个社团的关系很友好。

ex.en: The relationship between rent and bus fares decides whether a worker can live near a job.
ex.zh: 房租和公交费之间的关系，决定工人能否住在工作附近。

tip: relationship 比 relation 更常指人与人的关系。

senses.en: extremely large

ex.en: The map shows a vast forest.
ex.zh: 地图上是一片广阔的森林。

ex.en: A vast budget that never names the roof is still a leak.
ex.zh: 从不写屋顶的庞大预算，漏的仍然是雨。

tip: vast 比 big 更强调范围大。

senses.en: added to

ex.en: Two plus three is five.
ex.zh: 二加三等于五。

ex.en: A low fare plus a late bus is still a poor service for students.
ex.zh: 低票价加上晚点的公交，对学生来说仍是糟糕的服务。

tip: plus 可作介词或名词。A plus B。

senses.en: a kind of music with a strong rhythm

ex.en: Jazz is on the radio at noon.
ex.zh: 中午电台放爵士乐。

ex.en: A jazz concert that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can come.
ex.zh: 在末班车之后才开始的爵士音乐会，其实已经选定了谁能来。

tip: jazz 通常不可数。

senses.en: to put things into a bag or box
a bag, or a group

ex.en: Pack your bag the night before the trip.
ex.zh: 出行前一晚把包打好。

ex.en: Students who pack only what the list says leave room for a coat.
ex.zh: 只按清单打包的学生，还能给外套留出地方。

tip: pack 作名词是包，或一群。a pack of 后可接物或动物。

senses.en: very bad weather with wind and rain

ex.en: The storm started after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后暴风雨开始了。

ex.en: A storm plan should say who calls parents if the buses stop.
ex.zh: 风暴方案应当写明公交停运时谁给家长打电话。

tip: storm 可数。a storm of protest 比喻一阵抗议。

senses.en: what a person or thing is called
to give a name, or to say a name

ex.en: Please write your name in capital letters.
ex.zh: 请用大写字母写你的名字。

ex.en: A place can lose its old name when new maps care more about roads than about the people who named it.
ex.zh: 当新地图更在意道路而不是命名的人时，一个地方可能失去旧名。

tip: name 作动词是“命名”：name the baby。

senses.en: a place where aircraft land and take off

ex.en: The airport bus leaves every half hour.
ex.zh: 机场大巴每半小时一班。

ex.en: An airport far from the city helps flights, and it also makes the last bus home matter.
ex.zh: 远离城区的机场方便航班，也让末班回家的车变得重要。

tip: airport 是一个词，不要拆开写。

senses.en: a part of the coast where the land curves in

ex.en: The town sits on a quiet bay.
ex.zh: 小镇坐落在一个安静的海湾边。

ex.en: A bay that looks calm can still be a poor place for a school boat on a windy day.
ex.zh: 看起来平静的海湾，在有风的日子仍可能不适合学校的小船。

tip: bay 是海湾，比 gulf 小。

senses.en: many times

ex.en: I often review new words on the bus.
ex.zh: 我经常在公交上复习生词。

ex.en: Streets that often flood need a better drain, not only a warning after the rain starts.
ex.zh: 经常积水的街道需要更好的排水，而不只是雨开始后的警报。

tip: often 放在实义动词前、be 动词后。

senses.en: a person who supports communism
related to communism

ex.en: The history chapter uses the word communist.
ex.zh: 历史课用了 communist 这个词。

ex.en: Students can read the word communist without being told what to believe.
ex.zh: 学生可以读到这个词，同时不被要求信什么。

tip: 也可作形容词。本条是历史词汇，不是要求学生表态。

senses.en: a country with an elected head, not a king

ex.en: The text compares a republic with a kingdom.
ex.zh: 课文把共和国和王国作了比较。

ex.en: A republic still has to decide who may vote and who may go to school.
ex.zh: 共和国仍然必须决定谁可以投票、谁可以上学。

col: the People's Republic of China｜中华人民共和国
tip: republic 可数。People's Republic 要大写。

senses.en: a curved piece of metal for hanging things

ex.en: Hang the coat on the hook.
ex.zh: 把外套挂在钩子上。

ex.en: A hook by the door keeps wet coats off the floor.
ex.zh: 门边的钩子让湿外套不堆在地上。

tip: hook 作动词是钩住。

senses.en: not smooth, or not exact

ex.en: The path is rough after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后小路很粗糙。

ex.en: A rough estimate is useful, and the budget still needs the exact figure.
ex.zh: 粗略估计有用，预算仍然需要确切数字。

tip: rough 也可表示风浪大或粗暴。粗暴义不要用来形容同学。

senses.en: at the same time

ex.en: The bus was late; meanwhile the class waited.
ex.zh: 公交晚了，与此同时班级在等。

ex.en: Meanwhile the clinic stayed open, which mattered more than the speech.
ex.zh: 与此同时诊所还开着，这比那篇讲话更重要。

tip: meanwhile 是副词，可放在句首。也可作名词，较少用。

senses.en: a person who leads a meeting or an organization

ex.en: The chairman asked each class to speak once.
ex.zh: 主席请每个班发言一次。

ex.en: A chairman who keeps the clock also keeps the last speaker from being pushed out.
ex.zh: 守时的主席也能避免最后一位发言人被挤掉。

tip: 复数是 chairmen。现在也常用 chair 或 chairperson 表示同一职务。

senses.en: the unit of money in the US and some other countries

ex.en: The book costs ten dollars.
ex.zh: 这本书十美元。

ex.en: A dollar sign on a school poster should not be the only way a family learns the real cost.
ex.zh: 学校海报上的美元符号，不应当是家庭得知真实费用的唯一方式。

tip: 符号是 $。100 cents 等于 1 dollar。cent 已在本库。

senses.en: a place where people live, or an agreement

ex.en: The old settlement is now a town.
ex.zh: 旧定居点现在是一座城镇。

ex.en: A settlement of the bus argument should be written down.
ex.zh: 公交争论的解决办法应当写下来。

tip: settlement 可指村落，也可指协议。

senses.en: a purpose or goal
to intend or try to achieve something
to point something towards a particular target

ex.en: Our aim is to finish on time.
ex.zh: 我们的目标是按时完成。

ex.en: The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
ex.zh: 该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。

col: aim to do something｜力求做某事
with the aim of｜以……为目的
aim at a target｜瞄准目标
tip: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

senses.en: not thick, or not having much fat

ex.en: The ice is too thin to walk on.
ex.zh: 冰太薄，不能在上面走。

ex.en: A thin coat in this wind is a reason to open the lost-property box.
ex.zh: 这种风里一件薄外套，是打开失物箱的理由。

tip: 说人瘦时要注意礼貌。thin 也可作动词“变薄”。

senses.en: British spelling of realize

ex.en: She realised the clock was wrong.
ex.zh: 她意识到钟是错的。

ex.en: Cities realise a bus plan only after they write the time.
ex.zh: 城市在写下时间之后，公交计划才算实现。

tip: realise 是英式，realize 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。

senses.en: the people who work for an organisation

ex.en: The staff meeting is at four.
ex.zh: 职员会议在四点。

ex.en: Hospital staff on the night shift need a bus after the regular service has stopped.
ex.zh: 夜班的医院职工需要一趟在常规班次停运之后的公交。

tip: staff 是集体名词，谓语常用复数。

senses.en: a very young child

ex.en: The baby slept through the whole meeting.
ex.zh: 婴儿在整个会议期间都睡着。

ex.en: A baby clinic once a month is not enough for a village that is two hours from the hospital.
ex.zh: 对离医院两小时的村子来说，每月一次的婴儿诊所是不够的。

tip: baby 的复数是 babies。

senses.en: to produce words or pictures on paper
letters produced by printing, or a mark

ex.en: Print the notice before the network fails.
ex.zh: 在网络断掉之前把通知打印出来。

ex.en: A school that can print one page for a student without a phone is still fair.
ex.zh: 能为没有手机的学生打印一页的学校，仍然是公平的。

tip: print 也可作名词“印刷品”。

senses.en: large and impressive, or important

ex.en: The grand hall can hold the whole school.
ex.zh: 这个宏伟的大厅能容纳全校。

ex.en: A grand opening means little if the new library still has no books for the lower grades.
ex.zh: 如果新图书馆仍然没有适合低年级的书，盛大的开幕就意义不大。

tip: grand 也可放在称呼里，如 grandfather。

senses.en: the right to do something, given by someone

ex.en: You need permission to use the lab.
ex.zh: 使用实验室需要许可。

ex.en: Permission to leave early should be written, so the gate and the parent agree.
ex.zh: 提前离开的许可应当写下来，这样门口和家长才一致。

tip: permission 通常不可数。

senses.en: the clear liquid we drink
to pour water on plants

ex.en: Please bring your own water to the sports meet.
ex.zh: 运动会请自带水。

ex.en: When a city wastes water in dry months, farms downstream have less for the next planting season.
ex.zh: 城市在干旱月份浪费水，下游农场下一季可种的水就更少。

tip: water 通常不可数，不说 a water。

senses.en: an organized store of information on a computer

ex.en: The database lists every bus time.
ex.zh: 数据库列出每一班车的时间。

ex.en: A database without a paper copy fails when the network fails.
ex.zh: 没有纸质副本的数据库，在断网时就会失效。

tip: data 已在本库。

senses.en: one of two equal parts
equal to one of two parts

ex.en: Half of the class walks to school.
ex.zh: 班上一半的人步行上学。

ex.en: Cutting a journey by half still leaves some students on the bus for more than an hour.
ex.zh: 把路程缩短一半，仍有一些学生要在公交上坐一个多小时。

tip: half of 加复数名词时谓语常用复数；half an hour 中间有 an。

senses.en: American spelling of colour

ex.en: What color is your bag?
ex.zh: 你的包是什么颜色？

ex.en: The color of flood water does not tell you whether it is safe to touch.
ex.zh: 洪水的颜色并不能告诉你它是否可以安全触碰。

tip: color 是美式拼写；英式是 colour。考纲里两种都可能出现。

senses.en: ill, or about to vomit

ex.en: He stayed home because he felt sick.
ex.zh: 他觉得不舒服，所以待在家里。

ex.en: A sick child sent to school can pass an illness through a whole class by noon.
ex.zh: 带病上学的孩子，到中午就可能把病传给全班。

tip: be sick of 表示厌烦，不是生病。英式 feel sick 常指恶心。

senses.en: to experience something bad

ex.en: The village suffered from the flood.
ex.zh: 这个村子遭受了洪水。

ex.en: Students should not suffer in silence when the bus stops coming.
ex.zh: 公交不再来时，学生不应当默默忍受。

tip: 名词 suffering 已在本库。suffer from 后接疾病或困难。

senses.en: a thin piece of metal, or a cable

ex.en: Do not touch the loose wire.
ex.zh: 不要碰松了的电线。

ex.en: A loose wire in the lab is a reason to switch the power off and call an adult.
ex.zh: 实验室里松了的电线，是关掉电源并叫成年人的理由。

col: a piece of wire｜一根金属丝
tip: 本条只作安全词汇。不写如何接线。

senses.en: a person who hunts, or who searches

ex.en: The history text mentions a hunter, not a method.
ex.zh: 历史课文提到猎人，不是方法。

ex.en: A job hunter needs a clear form more than a long speech.
ex.zh: 找工作的人需要一张清楚的表，而不是一篇长讲话。

tip: 动词 hunt 已在本库。本条不写狩猎操作。

senses.en: a tool with a blade for cutting

ex.en: The knife stays in the kitchen drawer.
ex.zh: 刀留在厨房抽屉里。

ex.en: A knife in a school kitchen is a tool for food, and it is locked when the cook leaves.
ex.zh: 学校厨房里的刀是做饭的工具，厨师离开时要锁上。

col: a knife and fork｜一副刀叉
tip: 复数是 knives。本条不写如何伤人。

senses.en: able to harm you

ex.en: The icy steps are dangerous.
ex.zh: 结冰的台阶很危险。

ex.en: A dangerous crossing near a school is a planning problem, not only a warning to children.
ex.zh: 学校附近危险的路口是规划问题，而不只是对孩子的一句警告。

tip: dangerous 形容事物。处于危险中的人用 in danger。

senses.en: not bent or curved
directly

ex.en: Draw a straight line under the title.
ex.zh: 在标题下画一条直线。

ex.en: A straight road through a wetland may be faster for cars and worse for the water.
ex.zh: 穿过湿地的直路对汽车可能更快，对水却更糟。

tip: straight 可作形容词或副词，不要写成 straightly。

senses.en: to move forward, or to help something develop
progress, or money paid before the work

ex.en: The line will advance when the gate opens.
ex.zh: 门开后队伍会向前走。

ex.en: Science can advance and still leave a village without clean water.
ex.zh: 科学可以进步，村子却仍然可能没有干净的水。

tip: in advance 表示事先。advance 作名词是进展或预付。

senses.en: the state of being free from control

ex.en: The country marks independence in October.
ex.zh: 这个国家在十月纪念独立。

ex.en: Independence in study means a student can start without waiting to be told every step.
ex.zh: 学习上的独立，是指学生不必每一步都被吩咐也能开始。

tip: 形容词 independent 已在本库。Independence Day 要大写。

senses.en: buying and selling, or a kind of work
to buy and sell

ex.en: The town lives by trade with the city.
ex.zh: 这个城镇靠与城市的贸易过活。

ex.en: Fair trade in food means the farmer, not only the shop, receives a living wage.
ex.zh: 公平的食品贸易意味着农民而不只是商店获得足以生活的工资。

tip: trade 作动词是“交易”。

senses.en: belonging to the place where you were born
a person born in a place

ex.en: She is a native speaker of the local dialect.
ex.zh: 她的母语是当地方言。

ex.en: Native plants along the path need less water than a lawn that must stay green.
ex.zh: 路边的本地植物比必须保持翠绿的草坪更省水。

tip: native 作名词是本地人。用在人身上时要注意礼貌，不要带轻视。

senses.en: a piece of information sent to someone

ex.en: I left a message on her desk.
ex.zh: 我在她桌上留了口信。

ex.en: A text message about a storm helps only if it arrives before the road is under water.
ex.zh: 关于风暴的短信只有在路被水淹之前到达才有帮助。

tip: message 是可数名词。

senses.en: the salt water covering much of the earth

ex.en: We could smell the sea from the hill.
ex.zh: 我们在山上能闻到海的气味。

ex.en: Plastic that reaches the sea started as packaging someone dropped in a town.
ex.zh: 进入大海的塑料，起初是有人在城镇里丢掉的包装。

tip: by sea 表示经海路，不加 the。go to the sea 常指去海边。

senses.en: a building where people are kept as a legal punishment

ex.en: The history text describes the old prison.
ex.zh: 历史课文描述了那座旧监狱。

ex.en: A town that builds a prison still has to decide what happens to a person on the day they leave.
ex.zh: 建造监狱的城镇，仍要决定一个人出狱那天会发生什么。

tip: in prison 表示服刑，通常不加 the。

senses.en: a play in which most of the words are sung

ex.en: The opera starts at seven.
ex.zh: 歌剧七点开始。

ex.en: An opera that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can come.
ex.zh: 在末班车之后才开演的歌剧，其实已经选定了谁能来。

tip: opera 可数。

senses.en: having many parts
A group of buildings used for related activities.

ex.en: The problem is more complex than it looks.
ex.zh: 问题比看上去更复杂。

ex.en: Urban poverty is a complex issue that requires cooperation between governments, businesses and local communities.
ex.zh: 城市贫困是一个复杂问题，需要政府、企业和当地社区共同合作。

tip: 作形容词指复杂；作名词可指综合建筑群。

senses.en: a common food made from flour

ex.en: There is bread in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 厨房里有面包。

ex.en: Bread left out all day is not a safe breakfast.
ex.zh: 放了一整天的面包不是安全的早饭。

col: a piece of bread｜一片面包
tip: bread 通常不可数。不说 a bread。

senses.en: how hot or cold something is

ex.en: The temperature in the lab is too high.
ex.zh: 实验室温度太高。

ex.en: A city that records temperature near schools can see which classrooms need shade.
ex.zh: 记录学校附近温度的城市，能看出哪些教室需要遮阴。

tip: temperature 可数。have a temperature 常指发烧。

senses.en: a person or group that hates or fights another

ex.en: The story has no simple enemy.
ex.zh: 这个故事里没有一个简单的敌人。

ex.en: Treating a rival school as an enemy teaches the wrong lesson before a friendly match.
ex.zh: 在友谊赛前把对手学校当成敌人，教给学生的是错误的一课。

tip: enemy 可数。the enemy 作军队时谓语可用单数或复数。

senses.en: in the space or time separating two things

ex.en: The lab is between the library and the hall.
ex.zh: 实验室在图书馆和大厅之间。

ex.en: The difference between knowing a word and using it shows up when students write under time pressure.
ex.zh: 认识一个词和会用一个词的差别，会在学生限时写作时显现出来。

tip: between 多用于两者；among 用于三者或更多。

senses.en: at or to a great distance
distant

ex.en: The station is not far from our school.
ex.zh: 车站离我们学校不远。

ex.en: Families who live far from a hospital wait longer when a child is suddenly ill.
ex.zh: 住得离医院远的家庭，孩子突然生病时要等更久。

tip: far 的比较级是 farther 或 further；further 还可表示“进一步的”。

senses.en: a well-known statement, or something said

ex.en: There is an old saying about practice.
ex.zh: 有一句关于练习的老话。

ex.en: A saying about saving water means little unless the school itself fixes a leaking tap.
ex.zh: 如果学校自己不修漏水的水龙头，一句关于节水的谚语就没什么意义。

tip: saying 也可是 say 的 -ing 形式。作名词“谚语”是可数的。

senses.en: the main idea, a dot, or a score
to show direction with a finger

ex.en: The point of the story is to check your sources.
ex.zh: 这个故事的要点是要核对来源。

ex.en: There is little point in collecting data if nobody is responsible for acting on it.
ex.zh: 如果没有人负责根据数据采取行动，收集数据就没什么意义。

tip: point 作动词是“指”：point at / point to。There is no point in doing 表示做某事没有意义。

senses.en: a business, or the state of being with someone

ex.en: Her mother works for a bus company.
ex.zh: 她母亲在一家公交公司工作。

ex.en: A company that moves its factory should also say what will happen to the workers who stay behind.
ex.zh: 搬迁工厂的公司，也应该说明留下来的工人会怎样。

tip: company 表示陪伴时不可数：for company。表示公司时可数。

senses.en: not one, or not any

ex.en: None of the answers is correct.
ex.zh: 这些答案没有一个是对的。

ex.en: None of the night buses reach the village, so the clinic might as well be closed after dark.
ex.zh: 夜班公交没有一趟到村子，所以诊所天黑后等于关了。

tip: none of 加复数时谓语可用单数或复数；强调“一个也没有”时常用单数。

senses.en: a very large sea

ex.en: The river ends in the ocean.
ex.zh: 这条河最终流入海洋。

ex.en: Plastic that leaves a school bin can reach the ocean if nobody stops it on the way.
ex.zh: 如果沿途没人拦住，离开学校垃圾桶的塑料可以一直到海洋。

tip: ocean 比 sea 大。the ocean 常指海洋整体。

senses.en: a seat that swings, or a swinging movement
to move backwards and forwards

ex.en: The swing in the yard is for the younger class.
ex.zh: 院子里的秋千是给低年级的。

ex.en: A swing with a loose chain should be closed the same day.
ex.zh: 链子松了的秋千应当当天停用。

tip: swing 作动词是摆动，过去式是 swung。

senses.en: a room with a bath or toilet

ex.en: The bathroom on this floor is closed.
ex.zh: 这层的卫生间关了。

ex.en: A bathroom that students can reach matters more than a new poster about health.
ex.zh: 学生能够到的卫生间，比一张关于健康的新海报更重要。

tip: 美式 bathroom 常指卫生间。英式有时只指有浴缸的房间。

senses.en: to appear to be

ex.en: The question seems easy at first.
ex.zh: 这道题起初似乎很容易。

ex.en: A street can seem safe in daylight and still be dark for the walk home at night.
ex.zh: 一条街在白天可以看起来安全，夜里回家时仍然很黑。

tip: seem 后接形容词、to do 或 that 从句。

senses.en: related to the nucleus of an atom

ex.en: The chapter explains nuclear energy in simple words.
ex.zh: 这一章用简单的话解释核能。

ex.en: A town that discusses nuclear power should also publish the emergency plan.
ex.zh: 讨论核电的城镇，也应当公布应急方案。

tip: nuclear family 指父母和子女组成的家庭，不是核能。本条不提供任何制造或使用危险材料的方法。

senses.en: about science, or done in a careful tested way

ex.en: The scientific report includes the measurements.
ex.zh: 这份科学报告包含测量数据。

ex.en: A scientific claim about sleep should show how the numbers were collected.
ex.zh: 关于睡眠的科学主张应当说明数字是怎么收集的。

tip: scientific 是形容词。名词科学是 science，已在本库。

senses.en: an official rule

ex.en: The regulation is on the lab door.
ex.zh: 规章写在实验室门上。

ex.en: A regulation that students can hardly read is not one they can follow.
ex.zh: 学生几乎读不懂的规章，不是他们能遵守的规章。

tip: regulation 可数。

senses.en: the act of getting ready

ex.en: Preparation for the exam includes sleep.
ex.zh: 备考包括睡眠。

ex.en: Preparation that never names the return bus will fail the trip.
ex.zh: 从不写回程公交的准备会让这次出行失败。

tip: 动词 prepare 已在本库。preparation 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: a warning signal, or a clock that wakes you
to make someone afraid

ex.en: The alarm rang at seven.
ex.zh: 闹钟七点响了。

ex.en: An alarm that nobody can hear is not a fire plan.
ex.zh: 没人听得见的警报不是消防方案。

tip: alarm 作动词是使惊恐。本条不写如何制造危险。

senses.en: an official paper that proves something

ex.en: The certificate is in the office.
ex.zh: 证书在办公室。

ex.en: A certificate that families cannot read should also have plain words.
ex.zh: 家庭读不懂的证书，也应当配上明白的话。

tip: certificate 可数。

senses.en: in spite of that, or in any case

ex.en: It was raining, but we walked anyway.
ex.zh: 当时在下雨，但我们还是走了。

ex.en: The poster looks fine. Anyway, the real question is whether the bus arrives.
ex.zh: 海报看起来不错。无论如何，真正的问题是公交是否到达。

tip: anyway 多用于口语，常放在句首或句末。

senses.en: related to electricity

ex.en: The electrical fault closed the lab.
ex.zh: 电气故障让实验室关了门。

ex.en: An electrical repair needs an adult, not a student with a loose wire.
ex.zh: 电气维修需要成年人，而不是拿着松脱电线的学生。

tip: 电动设备多用 electric；电气系统多用 electrical。本条不写如何修电路。

senses.en: clothes in general

ex.en: Wet clothing dries slowly in this room.
ex.zh: 湿衣服在这个房间里干得很慢。

ex.en: Spare clothing at school matters when the morning rain soaks the first set.
ex.zh: 早晨的雨打湿第一套衣服时，学校里的备用衣服就有用。

col: an item of clothing｜一件衣服
tip: clothing 是总称，不可数。一件用 an item of clothing。clothes 已在本库，是复数。

senses.en: words that make something clear
a reason given for why something happened

ex.en: Her explanation helped us understand.
ex.zh: 她的解释帮助我们理解。

ex.en: One possible explanation for declining car ownership is the growing availability of reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 汽车拥有率下降的一个可能原因，是可靠的公共交通越来越普及。

tip: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。
